mei: Heads-up, q4a bringup of orbis-v1 landed to canary-pool-3 and our multilingual smoke showed two distinct regressions: CJK numeric token splitting and Arabic bracket orientation flip. Repro + quick examples below.

deploy-bot: canary deploy orbis-v1@q4a -> canary-pool-3 started (id: canary-5587) :rocket:

mei: Examples from the suite (zh->en, ar->en):
- input(zh): 价格是一百二十三元
  baseline (float): The price is one hundred twenty-three yuan.
  orbis-v1:q4a (canary): 价格是 一 百 二 十 三 元  -> produced spaces inside the numeral span (affects detokenization).

- input(ar): مرحبا (أحمد)
  baseline (float): Hello (Ahmed)
  orbis-v1:q4a (canary): (مرحبا أحمد)  -> brackets get attached/reordered, parentheses end up around the entire phrase and punctuation placement shifts.

mei: Quick local repro command I ran:
```
# run the multilingual smoke suite against canary
python infra/eval_runner.py --model orbis-v1:q4a --suite multilingual/locale_coverage_v2 --samples 500 --canary canary-5587
```

eval-bot: Run summary (multilingual/locale_coverage_v2, 500 samples):
- zh->en BLEU: baseline 34.6 -> canary 31.8 (delta -2.8)
- ar->en BLEU: baseline 29.4 -> canary 25.9 (delta -3.5)
- zh numeral tokenization mismatch rate: baseline 0.8% -> canary 7.9%
- ar bracket/orientation failures: 0.5% -> 4.3%

ravi: @mei thanks for the examples. Did you confirm this happens with both our off-the-shelf tokenizer and the fast variant? Could be fast-tokenizer binary alignment bug after quantization. Also check if kv-cache detokenization hook is trimming/adding spaces. :thinking:

mei: I ran encode() with python tokenizer (both fast and python fallback). Fast tokenizer shows the extra splits. Fallback python tokenizer keeps the numeric span intact. So likely a mismatch between tokenization preproc and fast tokenization behavior on the quantized artifact. Paste of token ids around the numeral (fast tokenized):
```
# token repr around '一百二十三' (fast)
['价','格','是','一',' ', '百',' ', '二',' ', '十',' ', '三','元']
# token ids: [4821, 7312, 58, 90012, 5, 12345, 5, 6789, 5, 2345, 5, 5432, 987]
```

sam: Interesting — extra 5 tokens look like SPACE token id (or separator) getting injected. Could be tokenizer pre-token normalization table referencing unicode category and quantized embedding table remap causes collision. Two quick angles: 1) is the fast tokenizer using a different normalization/regex at runtime? 2) does quantization change any tokenizer-trie fallback behaviour (weird but I've seen binaries accidentally ship different token vocab offsets).

ciara: I'll repro locally on my mac with the same wheel (orbis-serving-q4a.whl). If we can confirm it's the wheel (not runtime flags), we should rollback the canary and run a bisect between qparams scripts used in quantization pipeline. I'll also run a small bisect: quantize from q8->q6->q5->q4 to see where the token split appears. :mag:

ravi: Good plan. Also ping infra to snapshot canary instance logs (tokenizer init logs, vocabulary load sha) — @eng-infra. If the vocabulary file loaded at runtime differs (path or checksum) that explains bracket flip too (broken grapheme joiners for RTL punctuation).

mei: Actionable for now:
- ciara to run local bisect and confirm earliest q-level that reproduces (ciara assigned).
- sam to grep quantization pipeline (vocab remap step) and check any recent change in token id offset handling.
- ravi to request canary artifact + tokenizer checksum from infra and hold rollback readiness.
- I'll open a ticket with examples + eval metrics and mark as P0 for onboarding regressions.

ciara: started a small bisect, initial note: q8, q6 OK; q5 shows faint splits but not as bad; q4 reproduces reliably. Uploading artifacts to /tmp/orbis-bisect/ (will link when done). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: If q5 shows faint issues, maybe we can adjust q4 quant params (per-channel vs per-tensor) or tweak the FP->int rounding mode. Worth testing quick fix instead of full rollback if change is small.

mei: For visibility I rolled canary back to orbis-v1:float pool while we investigate (:warning: rollback done). Keeping this thread for diffs and triage notes.

deploy-bot: canary deploy orbis-v1@float -> canary-pool-3 completed (id: canary-5587) :white_check_mark:

ravi: thanks. Ciara, let us know when bisect artifacts + minimal repro script are up and I'll open a root-cause issue and link to this thread. :eyes:

mei: will do — attaching a short sample set (10 failing zh, 8 failing ar) to the ticket once ciara confirms. Thanks all.
